programmes.d: More efficiency, less weight and more sportiness is what Audi promotes in order to win the race against BMW and Mercedes with their A6 2.0 TDI. Also: Patrick Dempsey and his racing team at the Grand Am Rolex Sportscar GT series.

There are several kinds and sizes of pickups: based on passenger cars, light-duty utility vehicles or heavy-duty trucks with towing capacity up to 8.7 tons. Pickups are world-wide very successful. The Ford F-150 ranks second in the best-selling cars of all times. But why is that so?

The Stunt Heroes from Action Concept leave their headquarters behind and travel to a ski resort. Between the trees of a nearby forest they simulate the attack of an army of white-dressed soldiers. As part of this spectacular stunt they want to make a car explode and fly through the air.
We put the Wiesmann MF5 at the racetrack in Spa-Francochamps in the Belgian Ardennes to the test. Also: Audi A1 vs. Mini Cooper RS. And: the GT Academy 2011 qualifying rounds.

The Nurburgring 24 Hours is considered the most difficult long distance race in motor sports. Volkswagen set themselves this challenge with a car built especially for this occasion, their Golf 24.
The "Ferrari Challenge Europe" is an one-make series for Ferraris with seven races across Europe.
The Mercedes-Benz SL 65 AMG is the ultimate German muscle car in a tailor-made suit. Also: the Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG, the Formula 1 safety car. And: BMW's 6 series models.
The high-achiever at the 24 hours of Le Mans. The Jaguar D-Type won the toughest endurance race in the world three times in a row.

Hosts Mylene Gomera and Saif Hattawi invite petrol heads from the Middle East to bring their tuned cars to the 'The Walk' at Jumeirah Beach and have it rated in the categories speed, style and sound. Whoever receives the most points, wins a one night stay for two people at this glamorous Sofitel Dub
The "ASBK" is an australian motorcycle championship with up to seven events per season.

If you want to see out-of-this-world, customized or tuned luxury vehicles or posh cars you need to go to 'The Walk', the glamorous boulevard of Jumeirah Beach. programmes.t: Fim Supermoto World And European Championship 2026
programmes.d: The FIM Supermoto World Championship, also known as S1GP, is the premier international competition for Supermoto racing, first held in 2002.

People from the Middle East are crazy about their cars. On Put Your Car on TV they have the chance to present their tuned vehicles and judged. They are awarded points based on speed, style and sound and the car owner with the most points, wins a special treat for two from the Sofitel Dubai Jumeirah
The FIM EnduroGP World Championship delivers thrilling off-road action, with top riders battling on challenging courses with natural obstacles. A packed schedule showcases skill and excitement.
With the Bentley Bentayga, the traditional British brand is entering the fastest growing market segment. This world's first luxury SUV is a conglomerate of superlatives on wheels.

The Mercedes Sprinter belongs to the class of commercial vehicles. The light transporter is the dream for every tradesman. The third generation Sprinter is sleeker, more modern and more variable than ever.

The FIM X-Trial World Championship is an international indoor motorcycle trials championship that features some of the best riders in the world competing in highly technical and challenging obstacle courses.

We were allowed to drive a car of Citroen's sub-brand DS who try to set foot in the Formula E. In addition: Citroen and Peugeot share the same platform with their Rifter and Berlingo models. And: the facelift of the 508, Peugeot's flagship car.

Eager to overcome the damage to their image following the diesel scandal, Volkswagen allowed exclusive sneak peaks into future developments. We took their T-Cross on a covered drive. In addition: a first glance at Audi's A1 and A6 models.

The FIM Sidecarcross World Championship is an international motocross racing series featuring sidecar motorcycles. In this championship, a rider and a passenger (the "passenger" often referred to as the "passenger" or "monkey") work together to navigate challenging off-road tracks.

We compared the Ford Mustang 2.3 EcoBoost turbo to BMW's 430i with similar engine and drive specs. Also: Lada tries to take on Dacia with their Vesta SW station wagon. And: Opel's Grandland X may be an SUV, but it doesn't offer an all-wheel drive.
Is Kia's visually exciting Stinger able to convince in our test? In addition: we explored how Subaru's Boxer engine concept works in their XV model. And: Hyundai i30N vs. Volkswagen Golf GTI.
With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

The Monza Rally Show is a true classic amongst drifting shows. Since 1978 motorsport stars meet on the legendary Formula One course in the Italian city of Monza and hold onto the fly-off lever. Patron and MOTOGP star Valentino Rossi and his guests offer the fans an unforgettable show.

Sun's out, guns out - time to flex your muscles! In the United States and Europe alike, people like to show off their fast and exciting sports cars. We present the five ultimate convertibles for hot summer days.

It is one of the most spectacular automotive campaigns of the last ten years: 'The Beast of the Green Hell'. Stars of the video are four-time Formula One world champion Lewis Hamilton and one of the most spectacular super sports cars in a long time: the Mercedes-AMG GT R.

Camping vans become increasingly popular - even more popular than SUVs. And Volkswagen also wants to get its share of the market with the Grand California. After turning their Transporter into the well-established California, the German car maker now converts its Crafter into a motorhome.

One of the most exclusive cars in the world is the Pagani Huayra. Its counterpart is the Rimac Concept One, the world's fastest electric car with a top speed of 355 km/h. The Lamborghini Huracan O.CT and Arden Jaguar F-Type promise raw power.

The Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10 has its origins in the Japanese army. Its shape won’t win any beauty contests or achieve the best results in the wind tunnel, but this is not really the point with an SUV like this.
The IAA in Frankfurt is the largest motor show in the world. More than 900 exhibitors present their new products in 11 halls and on 14 outdoor areas. Here you can marvel at tomorrow's trends today.
The tuning forge SKN from Benstorf is organising a Dyno Day for the second time. Also: Lorinser refines the Mercedes E 500 Coupé. And: an invitation to Raeder Motorsport.
Monster Jam is an American monster truck series where drivers have to perform stunts and race against each other.
Patrick Simon tests the Aston Martin Zagato on the Grand Prix circuit. Also: Renault Megane Sport vs. Golf GTI Edition 35. And: the Porsche 997 and 994 on the Nordschleife.
Monster Jam is an American monster truck series where drivers have to perform stunts and race against each other.
The Icelandic Formula Off-Road is one of the most extreme racing series in the world and demands everything from the teams and their specially built vehicles.
Once a year, Las Vegas hosts the largest car and tuning trade show in the world - the SEMA Show. We show the highlights from hot rods to custom cars.
The "Australian Drag Racing Championship" is a regional motorsport series for top fuel dragsters that exceed speeds of roughly 300 mp/h in under 5 seconds.
The car tuner Lorinser looks back on more than 30 years of experience in tuning Mercedes Benz cars. Also: aeroplane vs. Porsche GT3. And: in an Aston Martin on the Nordschleife.
The Essen Motor Show is the event for automobile and motor sports enthusiasts. Over 300,000 visitors flock here every year and bring the hallowed halls to a boil.
The FIM QuadCross World Championship (formerly EMX Quad European Championship) is the premier international competition for quad bike motocross.

Ruf RT35 may look like a Porsche, but it really isn't. Since 1981, the Ruf company in Pfaffhausen, Germany, has been recognized as an independent manufacturer. But the basis for its vehicles comes exclusively from Porsche. A Ruf is even faster and more exclusive than a comparable Porsche.
We took the Ferrari 458 Italia for a spring ride around Lake Starnberg. Also: a test drive of BMW's 6 series convertible at the Table Mountain in South Africa. And: the Chevrolet Orlando family van.
The Icelandic Formula Off-Road is one of the most extreme racing series in the world and demands everything from the teams and their specially built vehicles.
Audi built only 333 units of its GT model. We tested the everyday use compatibility of the R8 GT. In addition: the Mazda MX5, the most popular roadster in the world. And: the Mercedes-AMG GT3.

The 2025 European Motocross Championship is the 37th European Motocross Championship season since it was revived in 1988. It includes 16 events and 6 different classes. It will start in Spain on 16 March and will end in Turkey on 7 September.

More efficiency, less weight and more sportiness is what Audi promotes in order to win the race against BMW and Mercedes with their A6 2.0 TDI. Also: Patrick Dempsey and his racing team at the Grand Am Rolex Sportscar GT series.

In Ron's Garage antique scrap piles from the desert get turned into rolling pieces of art in accordance with customer specifications. If you want to cross the desert, Mercedes has the perfect vehicle.

They are unconventional, they aren't mass phenomena, but in terms of price, they are proper alternatives to the long-established competition. These sedans fight their way to the top from the rear of the field. The Volvo S90 offers Scandinavian elegance and a high level of security features.
We put the Wiesmann MF5 at the racetrack in Spa-Francochamps in the Belgian Ardennes to the test. Also: Audi A1 vs. Mini Cooper RS. And: the GT Academy 2011 qualifying rounds.

What's hot and what's not. There are quests to be undertaken, the search for the ideal auto, for the perfect race track for the ultimate accessory gadget. What are the preferred rides of the race legends.
The Nurburgring 24 Hours is considered the most difficult long distance race in motor sports. Volkswagen set themselves this challenge with a car built especially for this occasion, their Golf 24.
This show brings you the best mix of national and international powersports from around the world.
The Mercedes-Benz SL 65 AMG is the ultimate German muscle car in a tailor-made suit. Also: the Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG, the Formula 1 safety car. And: BMW's 6 series models.

The GT World Challenge Asia is back for another season with five scheduled events for the season. Unlike its European and North American counterparts, GT World Challenge Asia also features GT4 entries.
The high-achiever at the 24 hours of Le Mans. The Jaguar D-Type won the toughest endurance race in the world three times in a row.

What a joy it is when elegance meets extraordinary performance! The Maserati Quattroporte, the Kelleners BMW GranCoupe and Porsche's 911 4S embody the perfect melange. We took a closer look at these prime examples of power combined with style.

Two weeks before the start of the famous 24 hours of Le Mans race, all teams are busy testing their cars on the traditional long distance track in France. Bad weather, accidents and a lot of tension, we documented the official test days in Le Mans 2013.
The "BRC" is a belgian rally championship where drivers of modern rally cars compete against each other on gravel and tarmac.

The Porsche 911 shows stylistic modesty like no other sports car in the world. It doesn't boast, avoids any loud appearance and puts form over function. We explored the history behind this iconic sports car and the reason why it has been so successful for more than 50 years. In addition: Porsche's T

The World Rally-Raid Championship is a rally raid series co-sanctioned by the FIA and FIM and promoted by the Amaury Sport Organisation. The championship's seasons culminate with world championship titles in both automobile and motorcycle categories.
The TER World Series typically consists of several rounds held on various tarmac surfaces across Europe. It attracts both professional and amateur rally drivers competing in different classes.
More extremes are always possible. Volvo's Laplander army vehicle has 6 wheels, 3 axles and provides space for at least 12 soldiers.

programmes.t: Aston Martin DB11 - The first turbocharged Aston Martin
programmes.d: Aston Martin are pursuing future success with their DB11 model. Apart from the beautiful new design, turbochargers are used for the first time, but, not to worry, the magnificent V12 remains in place.

Despite a production number of nearly 1.4 million units the Chevrolet Corvair is virtually unknown in Europe. It was innovative, efficient, modern and cheap. Nevertheless, it was slandered, torn apart and later reviled.

Winning the iconic Dakar Rally for a record 13 times, Frenchman Stéphane Peterhansel had a rather unusual career as he switched from motorbikes to cars and was enormously successful with both vehicles.

Alois Ruf is the founder of a small, but well-known car manufacturing company in Bavaria that specialises in building their own vision of street legal super sports cars on the foundation of Porsche bodys.
The 2026 Championship will be held over seven events, with five gravel rounds and two tarmac rounds, offering something for everyone.

From the 1950s to 1970s Hans Herrmann came to fame as a successful Formula 1 and sportscar driver for manufacturers like Porsche, Mercedes-Benz and Maserati who also won also the 24 Hours of Le Mans several times.

Tour European Rally is an up-and-coming rally series that combines some of Europe's most breathtaking and challenging rally events into one pan-European rally series. Each season consists of 5-6 individual events, plus annual TER promo events.

People called her the "Queen of the Nordschleife" when she used to drive her Porsche or BMW racing cars at the Nürburgring's famous Nordschleife. Sabine Schmitz was a successful racing driver before she took a career turn by working as a TV presenter.

Witness some of the world’s finest rallies with drivers pushing their cars to the absolute limit on gravel, tarmac and snowy roads. Brace yourself for spectacular onboard shots and mind-blowing speeds.
The European Le Mans Series is a multiclass endurance championship with several races across Europe.

In the US, SUVs aren't usually considered just workhorses but rather treated as everyday vehicles. Americans don't want to miss out on space, comfort and loading capacity. We show you the Chevrolet Suburban, Jeep Cherokee and GMC Yukon.

SUVs usually are rather impressive right out of the factory, but there are many tuning and customizing options. In this episode we present Kelleners BMW X5, the Mercedes Brabus B63 and the Porsche Cayenne tuned by Techart.

The GT World Challenge Asia is back for another season with five scheduled events for the season. Unlike its European and North American counterparts, GT World Challenge Asia also features GT4 entries.

When the Audi A1 becomes the S1 and the Golf gets an R in its name, these small cars turn into all-wheel beasts. Also: the Mini Countryman gets a rejuvenation. And: a test drive with the best-selling Volvo XC60.

programmes.t: Isle of Man - Tourist Trophy, Part 1
programmes.d: Tourist Trophy on the Isle of Man. The abbreviation "TT" could also stand for death and the devil. Every year the most dangerous motorcycle race in the world takes place. One lap in the Tourist Trophy is 61 kilometers long. 260 curves require everything from the riders. It's a unique myth.

The GT World Series Australia delivers high-octane GT3 racing Down Under. Professional drivers and top Amateurs battle wheel-to-wheel on some of Australia’s most challenging circuits in this fiercely competitive championship.

programmes.t: Isle of Man - Tourist Trophy, Part 2
programmes.d: The most dangerous motorcycle race in the world on the Isle of Man. Marshals at the TT are responsible for the highest possible levels of safety.

The emphatically sporty cars and motorbikes of BMW are equally successful with customers and in racing. However, the former aircraft engine manufacturer's entry into automobile production threatened to fail at an early stage.

GT World Challenge America is the premier North American GT series. Taking place on the best US circuits form Sonoma to Indianapolis, each of the seven race weekends features 90-min double-header races.

The Porsche 550 Spyder is small and fast, but only 140 units were built. It was Porsche's first racing sports car and laid the foundation for the German manufacturer to be considered a force in car racing today.

The GT World Challenge Europe is back for another season. The schedule consists of 10 rounds at high-level circuits, split evenly between the Endurance Cup and Sprint Cup. And once again, the calendar features the Total 24 Hours of Spa as the marquee event.
Racing has been a matter of the heart for Ford for over 100 years. Henry Ford already wins the first race with his first car. Thousands of other victories were to follow.
The development of engineering at BMW has always been closely linked to motorsport. Racing has always played a decisive role in shaping the brand and setting the pace for its future.
The European Le Mans Series is a multiclass endurance championship with several races across Europe.

In the 1980s and 90s, Porsche races from victory to victory. A McLaren with Porsche engine wins the Formula 1 World Championship three times. In Le Mans in 1982, Porsche starts an unbelievable winning streak with the new 956/962 prototype.
The Glas GT looks like a Ferrari, but comes from the province of Lower Bavaria in Germany. In the early 1960s it was one of the few German sports cars.

Speedway is the sport of 2,500 full-time competitors and over 2,300 casual competitors and their 8,000 odd crew totalling around 12,800 crew and competitors throughout New Zealand. Speedway excitement is experienced every week throughout the summer season from Labour weekend until Easter.
Peugeot released this classic, all wheel drive monster for one purpose only: It should bring the World Rally Championship to France. The Peugeot 205 Turbo 16 shook up the rally world in the 80s.

Lake Faaker is both a popular holiday spot in Austria and also a place with a special tradition. In early September, the region is the destination for thousands of bikers who celebrate their big annual event, the European Bike Week. (Part 1 of 5)

With 3.5 million units sold worldwide, the Mercedes Sprinter is one of the most popular commercial vehicles. Now in its third generation, it is more modern than ever. Thanks to numerous connectivity applications, it is intended to make fleet management easier.
